title: Jitter MCP
summary: Discover the latest features, updates and improvements of Jitter, the fast and simple motion design tool on the web. Try Jitter for free now.
body_markdown:
You can now use Jitter in your AI tool of choice with the Jitter MCP and produce animated content end to end without leaving your AI assistant. Create new files with a prompt, design and animate them from scratch, then adapt your designs to every size and language you need.


Here’s how to set up the Jitter MCP:


1. Copy the server URL:` https://mcp.jitter.video` .
2. Add it as a custom connector in your AI tool:[Claude](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp#h_3d1a65aded) ,[ChatGPT](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/custom-mcp-server#connect-a-custom-mcp-server) ,[Notion](https://www.notion.com/help/mcp-connections-for-custom-agents) , or any other platform that supports custom MCP connectors.
3. Sign in with your Jitter account when prompted.
4. Start creating right in the chat!


Not sure where to begin? Here are a few things you can try:


- Go from brief to content: “Using the launch brief we just worked on, create 3 animated social posts in Jitter.”
- Scale your campaigns: “Create 5 variations of this campaign with different headlines and calls to action.”
- Create on-brand content: “Use our brand guidelines to create an animated announcement for our new feature.”
- Repurpose designs for every format: “Adapt my product launch animation into square, vertical and widescreen formats.”
- Iterate on existing work: “Find my Launch Campaign file and make the animations more dynamic.”


Everything the MCP creates or edits is a native Jitter file, so you can always open it and fine-tune your animations by hand.


The Jitter MCP is in beta, so we’d love your feedback. Exporting, workspace actions, and one-click Claude and ChatGPT connectors are on the way.
